nrf24l01_init.message0: initialize nRF24L01 %1 CE pin %2 CSN pin %3
nrf24l01_init.tooltip: Create the RF24 object, initialize the SPI radio, and enable dynamic payloads. Power the module from 3.3 V.

nrf24l01_set_radio_parameters.message0: nRF24L01 %1 set channel %2 data rate %3 power %4
nrf24l01_set_radio_parameters.tooltip: Set the RF channel (0-125), air data rate, and transmit power. Both radios must use the same channel and data rate.

nrf24l01_set_retries.tooltip: Set automatic retransmission delay and count. Each value is in the range 0-15.

nrf24l01_set_auto_ack.tooltip: Enable or disable automatic acknowledgement on all pipes.

nrf24l01_open_writing_pipe.tooltip: Set the destination address and enter transmit mode. The first 5 bytes are used; shorter addresses are padded.

nrf24l01_open_reading_pipe.tooltip: Open receive pipe 0-5 with a 5-byte address. Pipes 2-5 should share their last 4 bytes with pipe 1.

nrf24l01_set_listening.tooltip: Switch between receive and transmit mode. Open a receive pipe before starting to listen.

nrf24l01_send_text.tooltip: Send up to 31 text bytes plus a terminator and store whether the packet was acknowledged.

nrf24l01_send_number.tooltip: Send a number as a 32-bit floating-point payload and store whether it was acknowledged.

nrf24l01_available.tooltip: Return true when a payload is waiting and remember the receive pipe number.

nrf24l01_read_text.tooltip: Read and consume the next payload as text. Check for received data first.

nrf24l01_read_number.tooltip: Read and consume the next 32-bit floating-point payload. Check for received data first.

nrf24l01_last_send_succeeded.tooltip: Return the acknowledgement result of the most recent text or number send.

nrf24l01_received_pipe.tooltip: Return the pipe number recorded by the last received-data check.

nrf24l01_is_chip_connected.tooltip: Check whether the microcontroller can communicate with the radio over SPI.

nrf24l01_set_power_mode.tooltip: Wake the radio or enter its low-power mode. Configuration is retained while powered down.
